svg.title: Two copies of the same store
svg.desc: Both price branches start with 57 units and share the generated random demand input. At SGD 6.50, five units sell and 52 remain, with SGD 32.50 receipts; this branch changes operational inventory. The unchanged SGD 9.00 comparison has one sale and 56 remaining, with SGD 9 receipts, using its own stock balance. ClickHouse stores both branches for running totals; only applied sales enter chain KPIs. Values illustrate the observed screenshot, not a guaranteed outcome.

text.tspan: Two copies of the same store
Example from the observed results: both copies start with 57 units of the same product.
ClickHouse records both branches and plots their running totals. Chain KPIs use only the applied branch.
